verified_facts.text: The resort is a 25-acre coastal property with a quarter mile of private beachfront access.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 25 Acre Coastal Escape with a Quarter Mile of Private Beachfront Access

verified_facts.text: The resort is just moments from Chatham's Main Street boutiques, galleries and restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just moments from Main Street's boutiques, galleries, and restaurants

verified_facts.text: The Main Inn was first built in 1914 and has been restored.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Main Inn was first built in 1914 and has been painstakingly restored to provide elegance at every turn.

verified_facts.text: The Main Inn was built long before modern zoning, and its setting could not be recreated today.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built long before modern zoning, its setting could never be recreated today.

verified_facts.text: Ocean View Rooms in the Main Inn are on the second and third floors and have a deck or balcony overlooking Chatham Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the second and third floors of our historic Main Inn, these rooms feature a deck or balcony overlooking Chatham Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.

verified_facts.text: Cottage-style rooms are spread across the grounds, many with private decks or balconies and select rooms with a gas fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many feature private decks or balconies, while select rooms include a gas fireplace.

verified_facts.text: Spa Suites have oversized hydrotherapy tubs, saunas, steam showers and fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: appointed with oversized hydrotherapy tubs, saunas, steam showers, and fireplaces.

verified_facts.text: The resort does not charge resort fees.
verified_facts.excerpt: We don’t believe in, or charge, resort fees.

verified_facts.text: The South Lounge is anchored by a restored antique Brunswick San Domingo bar from about 1880.
verified_facts.excerpt: The antique Brunswick "San Domingo" Bar c. 1880 has been carefully restored and now anchors the beloved South Lounge

verified_facts.text: Beach House Grill sits in the sand dunes of Chatham Harbor and serves clambake classics, clam chowder, lobster rolls and salads from the resort's farm.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the sand dunes of Chatham Harbor, the Beach House Grill is the premier destination for classic seaside favorites featuring clambake classics as well as clam chowder, lobster rolls and freshly-harvested salads from our farm.

verified_facts.text: Beach House Grill is closed for the season and plans to reopen in spring 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach House Grill is closed for the season. We look forward to welcoming you back in the spring of 2027!

verified_facts.text: Private beach clambakes include a private bonfire and a chef-led clambake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chatham Bars Inn’s private beach clambakes offer an unforgettable evening with a private bonfire, chef-led clambake, and coastal dining experience.

verified_facts.text: The Veranda overlooks Chatham Harbor with Mediterranean menus given a Cape Cod flair.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menus highlight familiar flavors from all areas of the Mediterranean enhanced with a Cape Cod flair.

verified_facts.text: The 8-acre Chatham Bars Inn Farm is in nearby Brewster and grows 125 varieties of vegetables, using techniques including hydroponics.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 8-acre Chatham Bars Inn Farm in nearby Brewster produces over 100,000 pounds and 125 varieties of vegetables annually, using innovative techniques including hydroponics.

verified_facts.text: In the cooler fall months, the farm-to-table dinners move indoors to the farm's glass greenhouses.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the cooler fall months, the farm-to-table dinner events move indoors to the farm's glass greenhouses.

verified_facts.text: The resort's own boat fleet is captained by U.S. Coast Guard-licensed crew and departs from an on-site private dock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exclusively owned fleet, captained by an exceptionally trained, U.S. Coast Guard-licensed crew, sets sail from our on-site private dock

verified_facts.text: Private charters include island trips to Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Customized experiences tailored to your interests, schedule, and group, including island charters to Nantucket and Martha’s Vineyard.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary daily launch, exclusive to resort guests, crosses the harbor to North Beach Island's barrier beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: A complimentary daily launch aboard BarTender, exclusive to resort guests, just minutes across the harbor to a quarter-mile of pristine barrier beach.

verified_facts.text: The North Beach Island Shuttle is closed for the season and returns next summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: The North Beach Island Shuttle is now closed for the season. We look forward to welcoming you back next summer!

verified_facts.text: Families have the Kids Crew program and an oceanfront heated pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the award-winning Kids Crew program to relaxing afternoons at the oceanfront heated pool

verified_facts.text: The Spa includes a relaxation room, private steam showers, a Zen Garden, a spa boutique, an outdoor pool and hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxurious amenities include a calming relaxation room, private steam showers, a peaceful Zen Garden, Spa Boutique, outdoor pool and hot tub.
